name: com.ezg.stats-overlay
description: Runtime stats overlay that always draws on top of the app — FPS, CPU main/render thread, GPU, batches, saved-by-batching, SetPass calls, draw calls, tris/verts, shadow casters, screen resolution and memory — the on-device equivalent of the Unity Editor Statistics window. Visibility is gated by a delegate the host game supplies, so it can be wired to a cheat or debug flag and stays invisible to players.
